structured_output.what_is_happening: DotFomo is a Pump.fun token that migrated to PumpSwap about 20 seconds after it was created (at about 00:27 UTC). Its links point to dotfomo.com, a site for ".fomo onchain domains", and the X account @dotfomo_. In roughly 35 minutes the price rose from almost nothing to about $137k market cap, on about $170k of volume, 1,900 buys and about 950 unique buyers. By the time the data was collected the price had already fallen from its peak. GeckoTerminal shows about $0.0000978, against $0.000137 when the rule fired and an all-time high of $0.000139, which is roughly 30% off the top. There is no paid DexScreener boost. A separate, similar-looking .fomo domain registry on Solana exists at fomosns.wtf, run by @fomodotsns. Its site does not mention dotfomo, and I could not confirm that the two are linked.

narrative.description: A 'utility' launch: a token tied to a supposed .fomo onchain domain service on Solana. The name may also be riding on the popularity of the Fomo trading app (fomo.family), but I found no link between this project and Fomo/FOMO Labs.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely launch momentum from the Pump.fun feed and trading bots, plus a website and X account that make it look like a real project. The volume has no organic news or cultural event behind it that I could find. Searches for the name, the ticker and the contract returned nothing.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the first pair created, and it is the one listed with the dotfomo.com website and the @dotfomo_ X account on its DexScreener and GMGN profile. It has far more liquidity and volume than the copies.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Four copycat DotFomo/DOTFOMO tokens were launched within minutes of it. All have $0 to $2.5k liquidity and negligible volume. Separately, a different .fomo domain registry exists (fomosns.wtf, @fomodotsns), which weakens the claim that this project is the '.fomo domain' product.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN classifies 79 wallets as bundlers, 38 as snipers and 207 as fresh wallets, with a bot/degen share of 37%. It detected 27 insider wallets linked by transfers, including one 11-wallet network. The dev's X account has launched 5 tokens, so this is a serial launcher. Searches for the name, the ticker and the contract found no organic mentions anywhere. The migration 20 seconds after creation points to a bundled or coordinated launch.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X (the post returned HTTP 402), and GMGN lists 13 smart wallets and 3 renowned (KOL) wallets as traders, so there may be real attention I cannot see.

structural_risks: Price is already about 30% below its high at the time of the report, so momentum is fading
Heavy bundler, sniper and fresh-wallet presence, with 27 insider wallets linked by transfers
Liquidity is only about $26–31k, so a few sellers can move the price a long way
The dev's X account has launched 5 tokens, so this is a serial launcher
GeckoTerminal puts the top 10 holders at about 50% (including the pool), versus about 27.6% with the pool excluded

structured_output.counterargument: Tokens tied to a real product with a website can get a second leg when the X account posts or a KOL picks them up. Buyers still outnumber sellers (189 vs 154 in the last 5 minutes), there are 13 smart wallets involved, and the LP is burned and the mint renounced, so a classic liquidity pull is harder. A pullback to about $0.0001 could be a base before another push past $0.00014. A double from entry needs roughly $250k market cap, which is not unusual for a Pump.fun token in its first hour.
unknowns: What @dotfomo_ is posting on X and how much engagement it gets
Whether dotfomo.com offers a working product and whether it is linked to fomosns.wtf or the Fomo app
Whether a KOL or call channel is about to promote it
Who is behind the bundler/insider clusters and when they plan to sell

source_coverage.notes: The X status page returned HTTP 402. X searches through the search engine found nothing for the name or the contract. dotfomo.com only showed the title '.fomo — Onchain domains'. I found a competing registry at fomosns.wtf. The DexScreener page returned 403; I used the GeckoTerminal API instead.

structured_output.thesis: A bundled Pump.fun launch with a thin 'onchain domains' story and no organic discussion I could find. It had already fallen about 30% from its high by the time of the report. A double from entry would need a fresh catalyst I cannot see, and the insider and bundler structure makes a slow bleed or dump more likely.
